function.name: Movies_3_FindMovies
function.description: Retrieves a list of movies based on the director, genre, and cast specified by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

directed_by.description: Director of the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the director is not a specific search criterion.

genre.description: Genre of the movie. Use 'dontcare' to include all genres or genre is not specified by user

cast.description: Names of leading actors or actresses in the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the cast is not a specific search criterion.

message.reasoning:
User wants a movie in "Imaginative fiction" genre. The function only supports certain genres: Offbeat, Fantasy, World, Mystery, Thriller, Comedy, Comedy-drama, Horror, Animation, Sci-fi, Cult, Drama, Anime, Family, Action, dontcare. "Imaginative fiction" is not listed. We can interpret "Imaginative fiction" as maybe Fantasy or Sci-fi? The user says they have started to watch a lot of fantasy-type movies. So likely they want a fantasy movie. We can ask clarifying question: "Do you want a fantasy movie?" But we can also interpret "Imaginative fiction" as "Fantasy". The user says "I would like to find a movie to watch in the Imaginative fiction genre, as I have started to watch a lot of fantasy-type movies lately, you know!!!!!!"

We can respond with a recommendation. We can ask for more details: director, cast, etc. But we can also provide a recommendation. The function requires director, genre, cast. We can set directed_by: dontcare, genre: Fantasy, cast: dontcare. Then call function. That will return a list of movies. Then we can present them. Let's do that.
